# ReadmeForge — Complete AI Agent Technical Reference (llms-full.txt)
> https://readmeforge.dev | Comprehensive schema, types, plugins, and integration instructions.

## 1. Zod Schema Specification (TypeScript)

```typescript
import { z } from 'zod';

export const UserSettingsSchema = z.object({
  github: z.string().default(''),
  name: z.string().optional().default(''),
  role: z.string().optional().default(''),
  bio: z.string().optional().default(''),
  location: z.string().optional().default(''),
  pronouns: z.string().optional().default(''),
  status: z.string().optional().default(''),
});

export const SettingsSchema = z.object({
  user: UserSettingsSchema.default({ github: '' }),
  theme: z.enum(['dark', 'light', 'auto']).default('dark'),
  accentColor: z.string().default('#8b5cf6'),
  badgeStyle: z.enum(['for-the-badge', 'flat', 'flat-square', 'plastic']).default('for-the-badge'),
  align: z.enum(['left', 'center', 'right']).default('left'),
});

export const SectionConfigSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  type: z.string(),
  props: z.object({
    content: z.record(z.unknown()).default({}),
    styles: z.record(z.unknown()).default({}),
    state: z.string().optional(),
  }),
});

export const ReadmeConfigSchema = z.object({
  version: z.string().default('1.0.0'),
  title: z.string().default('ReadmeForge Profile'),
  settings: SettingsSchema,
  sections: z.array(SectionConfigSchema).default([]),
});

export type ReadmeConfig = z.infer<typeof ReadmeConfigSchema>;
```

## 2. All 11 Plugins Reference

### `header-bio`
- **Category**: `header`
- **Props**:
  - `title`: string (headline greeting)
  - `subtitle`: string (primary role/focus)
  - `status`: string (current active status)
  - `showAvatar`: boolean
  - `avatarUrl`: string (optional custom image)

### `readme-typing-svg`
- **Category**: `animation`
- **Props**:
  - `lines`: string[] (array of rotating text phrases)
  - `color`: string (hex color without `#`)
  - `font`: string (e.g. `'Fira Code'`)
  - `duration`: number (milliseconds)

### `markdown-badges`
- **Category**: `badges`
- **Props**:
  - `badges`: Array<{ name: string; logo: string; color: string; category?: string }>
  - `style`: `'for-the-badge'` | `'flat'` | `'flat-square'`

### `github-readme-stats`
- **Category**: `stats`
- **Props**:
  - `showIcons`: boolean
  - `includeAllCommits`: boolean
  - `countPrivate`: boolean
  - `hideTitle`: boolean
  - `theme`: string (e.g. `'tokyonight'`, `'radical'`)

### `streak-stats`
- **Category**: `stats`
- **Props**:
  - `theme`: string (e.g. `'tokyonight'`)
  - `hideBorder`: boolean

### `activity-graph`
- **Category**: `activity`
- **Props**:
  - `theme`: string
  - `area`: boolean
  - `customTitle`: string

### `github-profile-trophy`
- **Category**: `trophy`
- **Props**:
  - `theme`: string (e.g. `'onedark'`, `'flat'`)
  - `noFrame`: boolean
  - `row`: number
  - `column`: number

### `pie-chart`
- **Category**: `languages`
- **Props**:
  - `layout`: `'compact'` | `'donut'` | `'pie'`
  - `hideProgress`: boolean

### `visitor-counter`
- **Category**: `metrics`
- **Props**:
  - `style`: string
  - `color`: string

### `snk`
- **Category**: `animation`
- **Props**:
  - `username`: string
  - `theme`: `'dark'` | `'light'` | `'matrix'`

### `social-links`
- **Category**: `social`
- **Props**:
  - `links`: Array<{ platform: string; url: string; label?: string }>

## 3. URL Hydration & Deep-linking
Any full profile configuration can be encoded into a shareable URL:
```javascript
const jsonString = JSON.stringify(config);
const encoded = btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(jsonString)));
const url = `https://readmeforge.dev/en/developer?config=${encoded}`;
```
Navigating to this URL automatically hydrates the store, populates the Monaco editor, and renders the markdown preview.
